description: This file contains utility functions for handling large text and file content within a task processing system, including token estimation, content summarization, and file read blocking based on token limits.

methods.name: allowVeryLargeReads
methods.description: Checks if the task allows reading very large files based on the current state.

methods.name: getTokenEstimate
methods.description: Estimates the number of tokens in a given output text for the task's API.

methods.name: getTokenLimit
methods.description: Calculates the token limit based on the model's context window and a predefined fraction.
